snippet.title: Why Your Browser Does This When You Type a URL
snippet.description:
Ever wondered what magic happens behind the scenes when you type a web address? 🤔 This video delivers a comprehensive URL explained guide, decoding the entire journey from your keyboard to a fully loaded webpage. We detail exactly what happens when you type a URL, answering the common question "what is a URL?" and exploring the fundamental URL meaning.

Dive deep into the essential URL components – understand the role of the protocol (HTTP/HTTPS), domain name, path, and more. Follow the step-by-step process:

Browser & DNS Lookup: Learn how your browser interprets the web URL and uses the Domain Name System (DNS lookup) to translate the domain name into an IP address. This is a key part of understanding the URL structure.

The HTTP/HTTPS Request: Discover how your device sends an HTTP request (or secure HTTPS request) to the web server holding the website's files. We cover essential internet basics here.

Server Response: Understand what the web server does to process your request and send back the website's data.

Page Rendering: See how your browser uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to assemble and display the visual webpage – the final step in website loading.

This web URL explained guide covers crucial networking basics and internet protocols. We even touch upon related concepts, like how a URL shortener uses redirection based on the provided URL. If you're looking for information like "URL kya hota hai," this fundamental explanation of URL meaning and function will clarify it.
